about: Teeth (H1 combat teeth, docs/team/hook/H1_combat_teeth.md): what a table night's tier asks of a human, on top of the night's own curves; numbers described in logic/Content/Teeth.cs. Measured with the harness's late hands: `arena --bot plain,deft,human,careless`, then tools/balance/danger.py. A tier with no entry is as it was. Tier 1, round 1 (H1, 3 Nov; 128 nights a bot at 12 min, kit on): fodder fall to 3 of her hits and champions to 9 (ember 0-10); the late human ends at 31% of life at its lowest and falls 15%, careless 20%, the deft hands win 96%; the boss comes at 10:00 and takes about 2:15. Round 2 (3 Nov): with the kit's bite raised, the tier-1 boss hits x1.1 (from 1.25): careless fall 22%, human 15% (lowest life median 0.29), deft win 98%; fodder 3 hits, champions 9.5-10, boss about 2:13. The director (H6 item 3, 4 Nov; logic/Play/Zones/ArenaRun.Director.cs, fields in Teeth.Director): pincers from behind, a leader cutting her off, a surround closing as the kit's wall, a stander charged, stuck foes recalled, the snuffer explained once; tier 1 only for now. H6 round 1 (4 Nov): heals were about six lives a night from drops and the crowd ran at her pace; both cut (fodderHeals/eliteHeals 0.35, fodderSpeed 0.7) so moving pays, plus the Ironback (a slow champion that slams a stander) and the pack feeding at its dead.
